category_edits.rationale: Optimize the mean positive-negative softplus margin loss, giving each valid training example equal weight with the existing sampled negative. This may improve HR@10 while preserving the GRU, sampling, and training settings.

edits.find:
valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    weights = torch.softmax(valid_neg.detach(), dim=0)
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()
edits.replace:
valid_pos = pos_scores[mask]
    valid_neg = neg_scores[mask]
    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    return pairwise_loss.mean()

change_summary: Replace detached negative-score weighting with mean pairwise softplus loss. No architecture or predictor changes are required.
